title: Kranthiveera Sangolli Rayanna
desc: Sangolli Rayanna, the army chief of the Kingdom of Kittur and a freedom fighter, revolts against the British in a bid to oust them from the country.

title: Bhakta Prahlada
desc: Prince Prahlada, the pious son of an asura king, must endure his father's wrath due to his unmoving devotion towards Lord Vishnu.

title: Aachar & Co.
desc: After her father passed away, Suma Aachar shouldered the family's responsibilities.

title: Yaare Koogadali
desc: Two friends escape from a mental asylum where they were wrongfully confined. Later, as one of them finds love, his dark past resurfaces and threatens their newfound peace.

title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages, where men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.
